label: organizational subsidiary or unit of
definition: Argument 1 is or was an organizational subsidiary, division, unit or owned organization of parent 2.
scope_notes: Direction subsidiary to parent. Explicit ownership qualifies, including partial ownership. Mere employment, a geographic base or business interaction does not.

facts.reason: Sears Receivables Financing Group is explicitly a subsidiary and unit of Sears.
J. Walter Thompson is a part/unit of, and owned by, WPP Group in the required child-to-parent direction.
Lorillard Tobacco is explicitly a subsidiary and unit of Loews Corporation.
NBC is explicitly a unit/subsidiary of and owned by General Electric Company.
Young & Rubicam is a unit and part of WPP Group and explicitly owned by it.
